headline.zh:
验证前快照，
事后看清它改了什么。
headline.en:
Snapshot before verify,
audit what changed after.

sub.zh: worldcheck 是编码代理的测试世界检查点工具：给每个任务一份可播种的一次性测试世界，把「测试通过」变成可复核的证据。
sub.en: worldcheck is the test-world checkpoint tool for coding agents: a seeded disposable world per task, turning the pass claim into auditable evidence.

title.zh: 可播种的一次性测试世界

body.zh: 一条命令从 compose.yml 加 seed.sql 拉起干净的世界，并把种子清单与状态指纹记进 manifest.json。
body.en: One command stands up a clean world from compose.yml plus seed.sql and records the seed manifest and state fingerprint into manifest.json.

body.zh: 同一份种子必然得到同一个指纹；改一行种子，指纹必然改变。状态是否被动过，一条哈希就能核验。
body.en: The same seed always yields the same fingerprint; one edited seed line always changes it. Whether the state moved becomes a checkable hash.

caption.zh: 从种子到指纹，一条机械链路
caption.en: From seed to fingerprint, one mechanical chain

body.zh: agent 自己搭的验证环境没有基线，也就没有审计。worldcheck 把环境的起点变成工具播种的世界：compose 定义服务，seed.sql 定义状态，manifest.json 记录证据。
body.en: An agent-built verification environment has no baseline, hence no audit. worldcheck turns the environment's origin into a tool-seeded world: compose defines the services, seed.sql defines the state, manifest.json records the evidence.

title.zh: 一条链路，五个机械步骤

body.zh: 清空卷、等待健康、灌入种子、抓取状态、写下指纹。没有一步依赖 agent 的自觉，全部由 docker CLI 完成。
body.en: Reset volumes, wait for health, apply the seed, capture the state, write the fingerprint. No step relies on the agent's good faith; the docker CLI does all of it.

alt.zh: up 命令的五个步骤与种子编辑验收说明
alt.en: The five steps of up plus the seed-edit acceptance note

title.zh: 单个二进制，一个外部依赖

body.zh: worldcheck 通过 stdio 调用 docker CLI，不用 SDK、不与 daemon 版本耦合；没有常驻进程，没有自己的数据库。
body.en: worldcheck drives the docker CLI over stdio — no SDK, no daemon-version coupling; no server process, no database of its own.

alt.zh: shell 到 compose 项目的架构分层图
alt.en: Architecture layers from the shell to the compose project

body.zh: pg_dump --data-only 的输出去掉注释、空行和带随机 token 的 psql 元命令，剩余行排序后取 sha256。同一种子必同指纹，改一行必变。
body.en: The pg_dump --data-only output drops comments, blank lines and psql meta-commands carrying a per-dump random token; the remaining lines are sorted and hashed with sha256. Same seed, same fingerprint; one edited line changes it.

note.zh: 输出逐字来自 docs/demo-results.json 记录的真实运行。
note.en: Output lines are verbatim from the recorded run in docs/demo-results.json.

body.zh: 清空旧世界，起服务，灌种子，写清单。
body.en: Wipe the old world, start services, apply the seed, write the manifest.

steps.output:

  service db (postgres:16-alpine)
  table projects: 3 rows

body.en: Services, row counts and the fingerprint, all from manifest.json.

body.zh: 模拟一次 fixture 修改：把第二组任务标记完成。
body.en: Simulate a fixture edit: mark the second project's tasks done.

steps.command: echo 'UPDATE tasks SET done = true WHERE project_id = 2;' >> worlds/postgres-starter/seed.sql

body.zh: 世界是一次性的：重新播种，从零开始。
body.en: The world is disposable: re-seed from scratch.

steps.output:
world postgres-starter provisioned (project wc-postgres-starter)
  service db (postgres:16-alpine)
  table projects: 3 rows
  table tasks: 6 rows
  table users: 4 rows
manifest written to manifest.json
seeded-state fingerprint: 9e0f82b6d9f6a412a92956f99844228a186354c1acac9e27a929980bac8bb6a5

body.zh: 不改种子再跑一次：指纹分毫不变。
body.en: Run again without touching the seed: the identical fingerprint.

body.zh: 需要本机 Docker 在跑；无需任何配置文件。
body.en: Needs a running local Docker daemon; no config file anywhere.

limitations.zh: m2（checkpoint/diff）与 m3（run + 对账报告）在本版本中是路线图桩命令。
limitations.en: m2 (checkpoint/diff) and m3 (run + reconciliation report) are roadmap stubs in this release.

limitations.zh: v0.1 只审计不回滚；diff 纯机械，无 LLM 判断；仅支持本地 Docker 与 Postgres。
limitations.en: v0.1 audits and does not rewind; diffs are purely mechanical, no LLM judgment; local Docker and Postgres only.
